t: You're at Bread Street Kitchen, a restaurant inside the One New Change retail and office development. It's owned by the chef Gordon Ramsay. His restaurant group was founded in 1997 and has won seventeen Michelin stars overall, and currently holds eight. He became one of the best-known chefs in the world after appearing in the television series Boiling Point in 1999. His signature restaurant is in Chelsea, but this one puts his name in the City, among the shops and offices of One New Change.
